description: Curated authentic-media resources per target language. Each resource carries topic tags and a rough CEFR entry level so worksheets can pick a matching podcast, video channel, artist, news site, film or radio station and print a QR code to it. URLs are intentionally conservative: official homepages or search links that will not go stale.
